carpet.rule.endGatewayDoNotAddLoadTicket: Do not add a chunk ticket after teleporting when the gateway is below the configured block
[bone_block] - Apply when a bone block is below the gateway
carpet.rule.dolphinPickupIntercept.name: dolphinPickupIntercept
carpet.rule.dolphinPickupIntercept.desc: Intercept dolphin pickup to prevent equipping items, restore 1.21.8 behavior, and limit repeated throws
carpet.rule.endGatewayCustomLanding.name: endGatewayCustomLanding
carpet.rule.endGatewayCustomLanding.desc: When returning from an outer-island gateway, land on the first safe adjacent block east, west, south, or north of an emerald block below the target gateway; otherwise use the vanilla landing position
